capacity_gate: unchanged: final capture of at least 90% of zero-start mean-response energy
scope: Training-only optimizer comparison with fixed dynamics, readout and targets.
optimizer: SciPy L-BFGS-B without box bounds, active coordinates only, fresh history
comparator: Completed refined-step Adam run: runs/capacity-warm-lr0001-dt0005; same parent, dt and 201 objective/gradient evaluations.
primary_comparison: Last accepted training MSE at termination within a hard 201-evaluation budget; report convergence, evaluation limit, iteration limit or failure separately.
secondary_comparison: Best accepted training MSE, all trial and accepted histories, actual evaluation count and elapsed time; independent endpoint replay and numerical checks.
failure_policy: Abort on a nonfinite objective/gradient; preserve failing parameters and last accepted checkpoint. No silent retry or replacement of the declared run.
